title: General.
officialText:
Factory-built barbecue appliances shall be of an approved type and shall be installed in accordance with the
manufacturer’s installation instructions, this chapter, Chapters 3, 5, 7, 8 of this code, and the New York City Fuel Gas Code. All
provisions for the construction and installation of fireplaces shall be complied within the construction and installation of barbecue
grills.
SECTION MC 907
INCINERATORS AND CREMATORIES
